functional.title: Verify trial task can be created successfully with all required fields
preconditions: User is logged into the application with a valid account that has task creation permissions
User is on the main task management or dashboard page
No existing trial task with the same name exists in the system

steps.action: Click the 'Create Task' or 'New Task' button on the task management page
steps.expectedResult: A task creation form or modal dialog opens with empty fields ready for input

steps.action: Enter 'Trial Task - Test 001' in the 'Task Title' or 'Name' field
steps.expectedResult: The title field accepts the text and displays 'Trial Task - Test 001' without errors

steps.action: Select 'Trial' from the task type or category dropdown if available
steps.expectedResult: The 'Trial' option is selected and the dropdown closes, showing 'Trial' as the selected value

steps.action: Fill in any other mandatory fields (e.g., description, assignee, due date) with valid data
steps.expectedResult: All mandatory fields accept the input and no validation errors are displayed

steps.action: Click the 'Save' or 'Create' button to submit the trial task
steps.expectedResult: A success notification or confirmation message such as 'Task created successfully' appears on screen

steps.action: Navigate to the task list or board view and search for 'Trial Task - Test 001'
steps.expectedResult: The newly created trial task appears in the task list with the correct title, type, and all entered details

postconditions: The trial task 'Trial Task - Test 001' is persisted in the system and visible in the task list
User remains on the task management page or is redirected to the newly created task's detail view
An audit log or activity entry is created recording the task creation event with timestamp and user

functional.title: Verify trial task details can be viewed after creation
preconditions: User is logged into the application with valid credentials
A trial task with title 'Trial Task - View Test' already exists in the system
User has read/view permissions for tasks

steps.action: Navigate to the task list or task board page
steps.expectedResult: The task list page loads and displays all available tasks including the trial task

steps.action: Locate and click on the trial task titled 'Trial Task - View Test' in the list
steps.expectedResult: The task detail view or detail panel opens showing the full details of the trial task

steps.action: Verify all displayed fields: title, type/category, description, assignee, status, created date, and any other metadata
steps.expectedResult: All fields display the correct data that was entered during task creation, with proper formatting and labels

steps.action: Check that the task status is displayed correctly (e.g., 'New', 'Open', or 'To Do')
steps.expectedResult: The task status shows the correct initial state as defined by the system's workflow

postconditions: The trial task details are displayed accurately without any data corruption or missing fields
User remains on the task detail view and can navigate back to the task list

functional.title: Verify trial task can be edited and updated successfully
preconditions: User is logged into the application with edit/update permissions for tasks
A trial task with title 'Trial Task - Edit Test' exists in the system
User is on the task detail view of the trial task

steps.action: Click the 'Edit' button or pencil icon on the trial task detail view
steps.expectedResult: The task fields become editable, or an edit form/modal opens with current values pre-populated

steps.action: Change the task title from 'Trial Task - Edit Test' to 'Trial Task - Updated'
steps.expectedResult: The title field updates to show 'Trial Task - Updated'

steps.action: Update the description field to 'This trial task has been updated with new information'
steps.expectedResult: The description field accepts the new text and displays it correctly

steps.action: Change the task status from 'New' to 'In Progress' using the status dropdown or workflow transition button
steps.expectedResult: The status updates to 'In Progress' and any associated visual indicators (color, icon) change accordingly

steps.action: Click the 'Save' or 'Update' button to persist the changes
steps.expectedResult: A success message such as 'Task updated successfully' is displayed and the task detail view reflects all changes

steps.action: Navigate away from the task and then return to the task detail view
steps.expectedResult: All updated values (title, description, status) are persisted and displayed correctly after navigation

postconditions: The trial task is saved with the updated title 'Trial Task - Updated', new description, and status 'In Progress'
The task's last modified date and modified-by user are updated in the system
An activity log or history entry records the edit action with before and after values

functional.title: Verify trial task can be deleted from the system
preconditions: User is logged into the application with delete permissions for tasks
A trial task with title 'Trial Task - Delete Test' exists in the system
User is on the task detail view or task list page where the trial task is visible

steps.action: Locate the trial task 'Trial Task - Delete Test' and click the 'Delete' button or select 'Delete' from the actions/context menu
steps.expectedResult: A confirmation dialog appears asking 'Are you sure you want to delete this task?' or similar confirmation prompt

steps.action: Click the 'Confirm' or 'Yes, Delete' button on the confirmation dialog
steps.expectedResult: The confirmation dialog closes and a success message such as 'Task deleted successfully' is displayed

steps.action: Search for 'Trial Task - Delete Test' in the task list using the search or filter functionality
steps.expectedResult: No results are found; the deleted trial task no longer appears in the task list

steps.action: Attempt to navigate directly to the deleted task's URL (if applicable)
steps.expectedResult: A '404 Not Found' page or 'Task not found' error message is displayed

postconditions: The trial task 'Trial Task - Delete Test' is permanently removed from the system or moved to a recycle bin/trash
The task list no longer contains the deleted trial task
An audit log entry records the deletion event with the user and timestamp

functional.title: Verify trial task appears correctly in the task list with proper sorting and filtering
preconditions: User is logged into the application with task viewing permissions
Multiple tasks exist in the system including at least 3 trial tasks with different statuses and creation dates
User is on the main task list or board view page

steps.action: On the task list page, apply a filter to show only 'Trial' type tasks (if task type filter is available)
steps.expectedResult: The task list filters to display only trial tasks, hiding all other task types

steps.action: Verify that all trial tasks are displayed with their correct titles, statuses, assignees, and dates
steps.expectedResult: Each trial task row/card shows accurate information matching what was entered during creation

steps.action: Click on the 'Created Date' or 'Date' column header to sort tasks by creation date in descending order
steps.expectedResult: Trial tasks are reordered with the most recently created task appearing first

steps.action: Use the search bar to search for a specific trial task by entering part of its title
steps.expectedResult: The search results display only trial tasks matching the search query, with matching text highlighted if applicable

steps.action: Clear all filters and search terms to return to the full task list
steps.expectedResult: All tasks including trial tasks are displayed again in the default sort order

postconditions: The task list displays correctly with all trial tasks visible and properly formatted
All filters and sorting are cleared and the page is in its default state

functional.title: Verify trial task assignment to a different user works correctly
preconditions: User is logged into the application with task management permissions
A trial task exists in the system and is currently unassigned or assigned to the current user
At least one other active user exists in the system who can be assigned tasks
User is on the trial task's detail view

steps.action: Click on the 'Assignee' field or 'Assign To' dropdown on the trial task detail view
steps.expectedResult: A dropdown or user picker opens showing a list of available users in the system

steps.action: Search for and select a different user (e.g., 'Jane Smith') from the assignee list
steps.expectedResult: The user 'Jane Smith' is selected and displayed as the new assignee in the field

steps.action: Click 'Save' or confirm the assignment change
steps.expectedResult: A success notification appears confirming the assignment change, and the assignee field shows 'Jane Smith'

steps.action: Log out and log in as 'Jane Smith' (or check the assigned user's task view)
steps.expectedResult: The trial task appears in Jane Smith's assigned tasks list or 'My Tasks' view

steps.action: Open the trial task from Jane Smith's view and verify all task details are intact
steps.expectedResult: The trial task displays all correct details including the assignment to Jane Smith

postconditions: The trial task is now assigned to 'Jane Smith' and visible in her task queue
The previous assignee (if any) no longer sees the task in their assigned tasks unless they have broader view permissions
A notification or email may have been sent to 'Jane Smith' about the new assignment

functional.title: Verify trial task status workflow transitions are enforced correctly
preconditions: User is logged into the application with permissions to change task status
A trial task exists with status 'New' or the initial default status
The system has a defined workflow for task status transitions (e.g., New -> In Progress -> Done)

steps.action: Open the trial task detail view and locate the status field or workflow transition buttons
steps.expectedResult: The current status is displayed as 'New' and available transitions are shown (e.g., 'Start' or 'Move to In Progress')

steps.action: Click the transition button or change the status to 'In Progress'
steps.expectedResult: The status updates to 'In Progress' and the UI reflects the change with updated visual indicators

steps.action: Verify that only valid next transitions are available from 'In Progress' (e.g., 'Done', 'Blocked', but not back to 'New' if not allowed)
steps.expectedResult: Only the permitted workflow transitions are displayed as available options

steps.action: Transition the task to 'Done' or 'Completed' status
steps.expectedResult: The status updates to 'Done' and a completion timestamp or indicator is recorded

steps.action: Verify the task history or activity log shows all status transitions with timestamps
steps.expectedResult: The activity log displays entries for each status change: New -> In Progress -> Done, with correct timestamps and user names

postconditions: The trial task is in 'Done' or 'Completed' status
All status transitions are recorded in the task's activity history
The task's completion date is set to the current date/time

functional.title: Verify trial task page loads correctly and all UI elements are rendered
preconditions: User is logged into the application with valid credentials
The trial task feature/module is enabled and accessible
User has a stable network connection and is using a supported browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)

steps.action: Navigate to the trial task section or page via the main navigation menu
steps.expectedResult: The trial task page loads within 3 seconds without any console errors or broken UI elements

steps.action: Verify the page header, breadcrumbs, and navigation elements are displayed correctly
steps.expectedResult: The page title shows 'Trial Task' or equivalent, breadcrumbs show the correct navigation path, and all menu items are functional

steps.action: Verify all action buttons (Create, Edit, Delete, Filter, Sort) are visible and properly labeled
steps.expectedResult: All expected action buttons are rendered with correct labels, icons, and are in their expected positions on the page

steps.action: Resize the browser window to a tablet viewport (768px width) and verify responsive layout
steps.expectedResult: The page layout adjusts responsively; all elements remain accessible and no content is cut off or overlapping

steps.action: Resize the browser window to a mobile viewport (375px width) and verify responsive layout
steps.expectedResult: The page adapts to mobile layout with appropriate stacking, hamburger menu if applicable, and all functionality remains accessible

postconditions: The trial task page is fully rendered and functional across all tested viewport sizes
No JavaScript errors or broken resources are present in the browser console
